children: Hagerty announced a secondary offering of 8,250,000 Class A common shares by Hagerty Holding Corp., with a 30-day option for 1,237,500 additional shares.
Selling stockholder Hagerty Holding Corp. intends to offer 8,250,000 Class A shares in an underwritten secondary offering.
Underwriters have a 30-day option to purchase up to 1,237,500 additional shares, increasing potential deal size.
Hagerty will not receive proceeds; the selling stockholder will use net proceeds to redeem corresponding HHC shares for the Kim Hagerty Revocable Trust.
Hagerty will bear remaining offering expenses; the selling stockholder will pay the underwriting discount.
